title: The Channel Manager
text: Where you connect car-rental brokers, publish your prices to them and receive their bookings.

title: OTA XML is where you work with brokers: websites such as Rentalcars or DiscoverCars that sell your cars.
text: They connect to this system over OTA XML, the standard language of the travel industry.

title: The status bar shows the health of every connection at a glance.
text: Broker updates, live channels, unpublished changes, blocking errors, stop sales and the last publish.

title: The menu opens the console pages: channels, dashboard, XML reservations, rate rules, API keys, bulk editor, stop sales, developer and this video guide.
Each broker is a channel. Pick one on the left to open its own pages.
text: Sample Broker is live; Travel Partner is still being tested.

title: A channel’s pages are grouped by job: Overview, Pricing, Connection, Operations and Publishing.
text: The next chapters go through each of them in order.

title: “Jump to…” (Ctrl K) finds any channel or page by typing its name.
